plan: Given my value of $13, I aim to maximize profit by winning the auction at a low cost. Bidding above $13 risks overpaying relative to my value. To outbid rational opponents, I will bid slightly above half my value, anticipating they bid similarly. This strategy balances winning odds and cost control. Therefore, I will bid $7, expecting others to bid around their value or slightly below, maximizing my chance to win and profit.

Given my value of $15, I aim to bid below my value to maximize profit if I win. The optimal bid should be slightly above half my value to outbid others who might bid conservatively. Assuming rational behavior from others, I'll bid $8. This balances the risk of losing with the potential profit if I win and pay a lower third-highest bid.

Given my value of $47, I want to maximize profit by winning the auction without overbidding. A rational strategy is to bid slightly below my value to ensure a positive gain if I win. I anticipate Andy and Betty will also bid close to their values. To minimize risk and still have a chance of winning, I'll bid slightly above the midpoint of the range, aiming to outbid them without exceeding my value. Thus, I will bid $35.
